title: Teledyne Technologies Reports Second Quarter Results
excerpt: Teledyne reported record quarterly orders, sales and operating profit, approximately USD 5.0 billion funded backlog, USD 284.7 million Q2 free cash flow and raised full-year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to USD 20.73-20.99 and non-GAAP EPS guidance to USD 24.45-24.65.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release supplies management commentary, segment trends, record orders and backlog, cash flow, leverage, debt repayment, and raised third-quarter and full-year EPS guidance; non-GAAP measures are treated as supplemental.
